body: CONSUMER-SEAM AUDIT AT EXACT BASE 003f12b — evidence first, then proposed courts. SOURCE FACTS. EditionFile stores content as String and derives Checksum.ofText. Edition.write converts every artifact through UTF-8, creates the destination directly, writes files sequentially, overwrites existing names, and appends receipt.json last. A failure after several writes can therefore leave an unreceipted partial directory or a mixture of old and new bytes. Edition.build is one Either comprehension: any Atlas, Codex, SVG, pagination, or HTML error discards the otherwise valid edition. It hardcodes ViewBasis.ResearcherReviewedFixture. Main accepts only the built-in War of the Ghosts edition. The private Json writer is suitable for the legacy receipt but must not replace canonical provider codecs. CodexHtml is reusable evidence for a static backend: it preserves the DOM text rail, refuses U+0000 and unpaired surrogates rather than silently changing canonical text, and has no external resources. PROPOSED CONSUMER CONTRACT. 1. Carry produced artifacts as exact bytes plus typed role, media/schema identity, portable path, checksum, and receipt. source.txt must preserve original bytes without a String round trip; canonical.txt, storymodel.json, result.json, and manifest.json must use their canonical producer bytes unchanged. 2. Lower each requested report independently from one admitted typed packet. A forced HTML failure after semantic success and preview.txt success must yield a valid partial bundle with HTML Failed and local-open Failed, not Left with no result. 3. Validate all planned paths before writing: relative only, no parent traversal, no empty segments, unique after platform-relevant normalization or case folding, and no collision with manifest or temporary names. 4. Write into an owned staging directory, verify produced bytes, and publish the manifest last. Define the nonempty-target policy explicitly; the current silent overwrite behavior is unsafe. Atomic directory rename may be a writer capability, not a scientific claim, and its absence or failure needs an execution receipt. 5. A file-open preview must not depend on fetch of sibling JSON, which commonly fails under file origin. Either render complete state into preview.html or load bundle-local assets by a file-origin-safe mechanism. The browser court must move the bundle beneath spaces and non-ASCII path components, disable network for the network-independent profile, and verify exact role checksums. 6. Define CLI exit status separately from semantic/report outcomes. A partial or refused scientific result can still be a successfully emitted, auditable bundle; process exit must not erase or reinterpret that fact. MINIMUM MUTATIONS. Original input with BOM, CRLF, trailing tab, and non-ASCII bytes; canonical text differing from raw; forced HTML failure after another report succeeds; mid-write filesystem failure; pre-existing conflicting destination; duplicate and case-fold-colliding role paths; mutated produced asset after profile certification; and preview bytes that try to fetch sibling JSON under file origin. These are consumer-side gates, not changes to the storymodel4s scientific contract. Exact StoryAtlas paths remain unassigned and unreserved pending the durable provider spec.
